noFalseCompletion.scenesWithoutOld44SelectionAreNotAutomat: The 44 selections are one older review subset. Scene may have another eligible unjoined museum painting, and OT minor scenes are explicitly not all mandatory.
noFalseCompletion.atlasLinkMeaning: An exact identical Bible reference is not a claim that art depicts exactly the right narrative submoment, location, or chronology.
noFalseCompletion.massLinkMeaning: 11 Mass-to-Atlas source candidates contain explicit typology and named persons, not 11 historical reenactments. Keep the Mass MC event and biblical scene separately represented.
noFalseCompletion.genealogyLinkMeaning: The 55 event records are curated research episodes, not interchangeable with the 3231-person raw genealogical donor. Scripture exact references can support occurrence co-links only.
noFalseCompletion.holyWeekSource: Passion subepisodes, procession/suppressed text and Gospel sequence must be distinguished from Mass liturgical action.
noFalseCompletion.rosaryMysteries: Assumption and Coronation remain Marian doctrinal/typological subjects even without exact historical scene link. Do not fabricate event geolocation.
